title: Hub settlement batch
description: The stored Batch record built by lib/hub/ledger.js buildBatch() — the Addendum-B settlement journal's unit of "a set of rows reserved to be paid together", keyed by the program version they pay under. A batch draws ONLY on each wallet's `available` (accrued − paidApplied − reserved) at the moment it is built; per-row state (pending/partial/paid/waived) is a DERIVED projection from the settlement journal (see receipt.schema.json / lib/hub/ledger.js rowState, batchView) and is not stored on the batch itself. `state` here is the batch's own stored lifecycle: `pending` (open, may still receive settlements or be cancelled), `cancelled` (closed with nothing settled — every row's remainder returned to available), `closed` (cancelled after at least one row settled — a partial row's remainder STAYS reserved on the row until an owner waive). `sent` is a DISPLAY state lib/hub/ledger.js batchView() reports once every row's remainder has reached zero; it is never written back to storage. THIS IS THE CORE ENTITY, not a specific HTTP response body: operator-facing routes (GET/POST /api/hub/:project/payout, /desk) decorate it with additional display-only fields (`airdropLines`, `mint`, `rows`, `remainingRaw`, `remainingLines`, `remainingCount`) that this schema does not cover, and (as of this writing) that live route path still runs on the pre-Addendum-B lib/cuna-payout.js batch/paid model rather than this one — see lib/hub/README.md for the wiring status.

$schema.description: present when the serving route stamps it — points back at this file's served URL.

projectId.description: which project this batch belongs to — checked on every settlement (a batch id from project A is refused by project B, design §3).

at.description: unix seconds this batch was built.

programVersion.description: the `version` number of the program-version.schema.json record this batch pays under. Every row in the batch pays at that version's terms.

programHash.description: that program version's `hash`, copied onto the batch so a receipt can show which terms produced it without a second lookup.

rewardMint.description: the mint every amount on this batch is denominated in.

rewardDecimals.description: decimals of `rewardMint` — every *Raw amount on this batch is raw base units at this precision.

periods.description: the accrual period keys (day "YYYY-MM-DD" or hourly slice "YYYY-MM-DDTHH") this batch was raised to cover — informational; a batch pays each wallet's whole `available`, not a period-by-period slice.

state.description: pending = open; cancelled = closed with nothing settled; closed = cancelled with at least one settled or partial row; sent = every row fully settled or waived (a DISPLAY value derived from the settlement journal, never itself stored).

amounts.description: wallet address → raw amount reserved for that wallet on this batch, as a decimal-digit string (BigInt on the wire as a string, never a JS number). Keys are dynamic wallet addresses, so they are not individually declared here; every value has the shape `"[0-9]+"`.

skippedBelowFloor.description: wallet address → the raw amount that was available but excluded because it was below the batch's `minPayoutRaw` floor. Same value shape as `amounts`.

totalRaw.description: sum of every value in `amounts` — the total this batch will move if fully settled.

reservedFundingRaw.description: equal to `totalRaw` at creation — what this batch reserves out of the project's funding-status `reservedRaw` roll-up.

waived.description: wallet address → { amountRaw, by: "owner", at, reason } for a remainder the OWNER released back to `available` on a `closed` batch (lib/hub/ledger.js waiveRemainder — never an operator action). The money is still owed; the next batch draws it. Empty ({}) on a batch nothing has been waived on.

attempts.description: OPTIONAL — present once a row has gone through the signed-attempt flow (lib/hub/attempts.js, design §4 rev 4): wallet address → { attemptId, state: pending|signing|submitted|settled|failed, amountRaw, recentBlockhash, lastValidBlockHeight, startedAt, sig, sigAt, reconciles: [...], failed: [...] }. This state machine is implemented and unit-tested (scripts/hub-attempts-test.cjs) but is not yet reachable from any HTTP route.
